t2.thesis: CIFR has sold off hard into the print after convert dilution, with 27% short interest and bullish option skew, while the sector shrugged off strong quarters and has rate and leverage worries; the net edge over the base rate is roughly zero.
reasons: Deeply oversold: down 49% in 1m and 72% off the 52w high, with short interest of 27% of float, which leaves room for a relief or squeeze move
Option positioning tilts bullish: call IV above put IV, put/call volume of 0.24 and negative put skew
Last 4 BMO prints rose 3 of 4 times despite EPS misses; the market trades leases and delivery milestones, not EPS
Peer APLD fell more than 30% after a record quarter, and the sector is under pressure from rate-hike fears hitting debt-heavy builders
Barber Lake delivery was pushed out to Q4-26/Q1-27, and the cost overrun ($359M borne by Cipher) could dominate the call
t2.deciding_variable: Whether the release includes new lease signings or a reaffirmed Barber Lake and Black Pearl delivery and rent schedule, versus further delays, cost overruns or new financing needs.

prior.from: I3 by_cluster ai_infra t0_hit 0.558 (n=43), cross-checked against BMO 0.548 and overall ~0.54; the crypto_proxy rate of 0.25 rests on only n=8 and is flagged insufficient, so it was ignored

t2.leak_probe: I don't know: that earnings report (November 2, 2026) hasn't happened yet as of today (October 29, 2026), and it's also past my knowledge cutoff, so there's no post-earnings stock move to report.
t2.moved_from_prior: Roughly a wash, net about -0.01. Oversold conditions, short interest, bullish skew and the reaction history push up about +0.03. Sector contagion (APLD falling after a strong print), leverage and rate fears, weekend gap risk across a Fri-open to Mon-open window, and possible lingering convert-hedge selling push down about -0.04.
